insight: Runs agent workflows in production at Uber, LinkedIn, Klarna, Replit and JPMorgan.
name: LangGraph
tagline: Graph-based agent orchestration. Stateful loops with checkpoints.
description: LangChain's agent layer. Model agents as nodes in a state graph with persistent checkpoints, human-in-the-loop steps, and durable execution. Strong when you need a long-running, debuggable agent rather than a one-shot chain.
edge: Durable checkpointed state-graph with human-in-the-loop — long agent runs pause and resume, unlike one-shot chains.
